title.value: Towards robust and replicable sex differences in the intrinsic brain function of autism
title.justification: The title explicitly mentions the focus on examining sex differences in the intrinsic brain function related to autism.
title.quote: Towards robust and replicable sex differences in the intrinsic brain function of autism

analysis.description: This study investigates sex differences in the intrinsic brain function of individuals with autism, focusing on examining resting-state functional connectivity in a large sample of males and females. It evaluates the robustness and replicability of observed differences by using different pre-processing methods and independent datasets.

type.justification: The study involves empirical analyses of resting-state fMRI data to identify sex differences in autism, using statistical models and validation across independent datasets.
type.quote: Methods: We addressed this gap by using a large sample of males and females with autism... Discovery analyses examined main effects of diagnosis, sex and their interaction...

name.justification: The research focuses on examining neural connectivity differences in autism using neuroimaging techniques, specifically resting-state fMRI.
name.quote: resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (R-fMRI) has proven to be a valuable complementary tool for investigating atypicalities in intrinsic functional connectivity (iFC).

name.justification: The study evaluates different R-fMRI metrics related to functional connectivity in the brain.
name.quote: Discovery analyses in ABIDE revealed significant main effects of diagnosis and sex across the intrinsic functional connectivity...

name.justification: The primary analysis and findings are centered around understanding sex differences in neural connectivity in the context of autism.
name.quote: We examined autism-related sex differences for intrinsic functional brain organization across multiple R-fMRI metrics...

name.justification: The ABIDE dataset is used as the primary discovery dataset in this study, providing a large sample of fMRI data.
name.quote: Discovery sample: ABIDE I and II... For discovery analyses, we examined the R-fMRI dataset with one of the largest number of females and males in both the autism and the NT groups available...
